purpose: Teach: 苦しめ/多量/容姿/昼過ぎ/晴天/言わば/手渡し/向っ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、弟を苦しめてただろ
lines.en: Riku, you were messing with your brother, weren't you.
lines.style: Accusatory but not unkind. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone calling out a friend for something she knows he'll own up to. Slight knowing edge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、多量のお菓子を一気に食ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were inhaling snacks like they were going out of style, Sakura.
lines.style: Rapid-fire comeback. Playful deflection. Light, unbothered rhythm. Quick smile in the voice, turning her own logic back on her without malice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、容姿で人を判断するなって母さんに言われたろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't your mom tell you not to judge people by their looks.
lines.style: Lecturing undertone but teasing. Sitting back slightly. The rhythm of someone quoting a parent back at someone else. Mock-serious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、昼過ぎから塾に行くな、桜
lines.en: You head off to cram school right after lunch, Sakura.
lines.style: Turning the tables smoothly. Observant, caught-you tone. Not defensive — just methodical. Counting her hypocrisies on his fingers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、今日は晴天だから外行こうぜ
lines.en: Riku, it's clear out today — let's go outside.
lines.style: Shift in energy. Lighter, genuinely sunny. The invitation underneath the directness. A moment of reaching past the banter. Still casual but warmer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、言わばクラスのムードメーカーだな、桜
lines.en: You're basically the class mood-maker, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter register. The compliment lands because he's not performing it. Direct eye contact, slight softness in the voice. The honesty that comes after the sparring.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ノートを手渡しで返してくれ
lines.en: Riku, hand me the notebook back, would you.
lines.style: Back to business but warmer than the opening. Direct request, no ceremony. The comfort of returning to small practical things together.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅に向って走ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were sprinting toward the station, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Not accusatory this time. Curiosity underneath — wondering where she was rushing to, why. The tone of noticing without pushing.
